about: Recall cases: repositories a person found that github-scout must find. Each gives the goal as a user would say it and the repos the report or the scan must contain. Add one whenever someone finds a good repo the tool missed.

evals.prompt: Use github-scout: our operations scripts must read and post on Reddit, X and Xiaohongshu through the Chrome profile we are already logged into, without a model clicking pages.
evals.note: Agents searched 'social media automation' and missed it; a person found it on X. Entity pairs and 'logged-in browser' put it first.

evals.prompt: Use github-scout: let an agent (Opus 5.5) make short explainer videos that show how a machine or a system works.
evals.note: Its own words never say video; people make explainer videos with its interactive figures. Found only by the rising lens.

evals.prompt: 用 github-scout：让 agent 写的中文公众号长文读不出 AI 味。
evals.note: Chinese projects; tramstop is found by the Chinese term 人味, not by an English translation.

evals.prompt: 用 github-scout：研究 GitHub 上用 Claude Code（特别是 Opus 5.5）或 Codex 做视频的 skill、工作流、素材制作和下载方法，视频用于自媒体（起号、产品宣传、科普），覆盖画风、动画、转场、特效、素材、音效、剪辑，最后给完整登记表。
evals.note: ChatGPT Pro run 2026-10-17 listed 84 repos but missed these three, the local picks for agents that check their own cut; all three are linked from zhuyansen/awesome-claude-video-skills, which that run opened and did not read.
